analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· vs SMA100/200($428.60/$429.44) at +14.49%/+12.29%: Maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week Position (69.7%): Price level approximately 11% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (54.8→54.8): Staying in neutral zone, lacking directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (Hist -3.6682→-3.6682): Holding steady without improvement or deterioration, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $494.22): Sideways movement near the middle band, with reduced volatility at 7.85% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day Low($489.80) not meeting 20-day Low($477.15) * 1.005, 5-day High($515.65) not meeting 20-day High($517.78) * 0.995 → Sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.66x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): Lacking clear direction, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see stance.
